# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(clustree)
library(scater)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)
library(viridis)
library(Polychrome)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Perform data integration using *Seurat*

## Prepare the datasets for integration

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)  # 2 GB

object <- here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Integrated.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  seu <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Celltypist_annotated.Seurat.rds"))
  
  # remove cells annotated as low quality
  seu <- seu[, seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting != "LOW_QUALITY"]
  seu_int <- integrateDataset(seu, "Dataset")
  
  # set factors and levels to help create the legend for visualisations
  seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting <- sortedFactor(seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting)
  seu_int$pan_fetal.predicted_labels <- sortedFactor(seu_int$pan_fetal.predicted_labels)
  seu_int$fetal_organ.majority_voting <- sortedFactor(seu_int$fetal_organ.majority_voting)
  seu_int$fetal_organ.predicted_labels <- sortedFactor(seu_int$fetal_organ.predicted_labels)
  
  seu_int$Donor <- ifelse(seu_int$Sample %in% c("1AFa", "1AFb"), "1AF", seu_int$Sample)
  seu_int$Donor.gest_age <- factor(seu_int$Donor, levels = c("4AF", "8AF", "6AF", "5AF", "1AF", "7AF", "2AF"))
  seu_int$Donor.early_mid_late <- ifelse(seu_int$gest_age_weeks == 20, "Mid Gestation",
                                     ifelse(seu_int$gest_age_weeks < 20, "Early Gestation",
                                            "Late Gestation"))
  
  saveRDS(seu_int, object)
} else {
  seu_int <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r}
seu_int$Donor.Paper <- unname(DONOR.PAPER[seu_int$Donor])
seu_int$Donor.Paper <- factor(seu_int$Donor.Paper)

seu_int$Sample.Paper <- unname(SAMPLE.PAPER[seu_int$Sample])
seu_int$Sample.Paper <- factor(seu_int$Sample.Paper)

seu_int$early_late_gestation <- ifelse(seu_int$gest_age_weeks == 20, "Mid", 
                                       ifelse(seu_int$gest_age_weeks < 20, 
                                              "Early", "Late"))

seu_int$Donor.gest_age <- factor(seu_int$Donor.Paper, levels = c("AF_3", "AF_7", "AF_5", "AF_4", 
                                                           "AF_1", "AF_6", "AF_2"))

dim(seu_int)
```

There are `r ncol(seu_int)` cells present in this dataset across all samples.

# Perform clustering using *Seurat*

We will first under-cluster the dataset then sub-cluster it.

```{r}
ElbowPlot(seu_int, ndims = 30)
```

```{r}
seu_int <- FindNeighbors(seu_int, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
seu_int <- RunUMAP(seu_int, dims = 1:30)

object <- here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Integrated_clustered_all_res.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
    
  seu_int <- FindClusters(seu_int, algorithm = 3,
                          resolution = seq(0.01, 0.1, by = 0.01))
  
  saveRDS(seu_int, object)
} else {
  seu_int <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r, fig.asp=1.5}
clustree(seu_int, prefix = "integrated_snn_res.")
```

```{r}
# merge all the subcluster labels into one variable
seu_int$all_clusters <- as.character(seu_int$seurat_clusters)

seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "0",
                               seu_int.sub0$sub.cluster,
                               seu_int$all_clusters)

seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "1",
                               seu_int.sub1$sub.cluster,
                               seu_int$all_clusters)

seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "2",
                               seu_int.sub2$sub.cluster,
                               seu_int$all_clusters)

seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "3",
                               seu_int.sub3$sub.cluster,
                               seu_int$all_clusters)

table(seu_int$all_clusters)
length(names(table(seu_int$all_clusters)))
```

```{r}
object <- here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Integrated_clustered.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # update the default clustering resolution to our chosen one
  seu_int$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(seu_int$all_clusters)
  Idents(seu_int) <- seu_int$seurat_clusters
  
  saveRDS(seu_int, object)
} else {
  seu_int <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

  ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,

  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
  NoLegend() +
  ylim(0, 1600) +
  xlab("Seurat clusters") +
  ylab("Number of cells") + ggtitle("Seurat Clusters")
```
